name: Water Elementals
summary: On the island off the coast, Water Elementals may offer a clue to the Stone of the Tides' curse. Baron Revilgaz wants their bracers examined for a way to counter it.

sections.title: Curbing the Curse
sections.body: Baron Revilgaz suspects the Water Elementals' magical residue may help fight the Stone of the Tides' curse. The stone is said to make anyone who wields it drift in and out of reality. So he sends you back to the island off the coast to gather bracers for the scholarly mages of Dalaran to examine.

sections.title: Booty Bay's Master
sections.body: Baron Revilgaz admits he lacks the skill to judge whether the bracers can help. He refuses to leave Booty Bay just to speak with tiresome old mages. So he sends you north to have a mage examine them.

faq.q: Who wants the water elemental bracers?
faq.answer: Baron Revilgaz, leader of the Blackwater Raiders in Booty Bay, wants the bracers examined for clues to the magic surrounding the Stone of the Tides.

faq.q: Why does Baron Revilgaz need elemental bracers?
aliases: curse of the stone of the tides
faq.answer: Revilgaz hopes the bracers' magical residue will reveal how to counter the Stone of the Tides' curse. The curse makes its bearer fade in and out of existence.
Baron Revilgaz believes Gazban, a goblin wizard said to have found the Stone of the Tides, conjured the Water Elementals.

faq.q: Where does this task lead next?
faq.answer: Revilgaz sends the bracers north to Dalaran, where a mage can examine their residue.

faq.q: Why doesn't Revilgaz take the bracers to Dalaran himself?
faq.answer: Revilgaz refuses to leave Booty Bay just to speak with tiresome old mages. He insists he has nothing to fear from would-be rivals.
